scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && uv sync --project observer && lefthook install
scripts.py:lint: cd observer && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.check:fast: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm py:lint
scripts.check: pnpm gen:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm site:build && pnpm py:lint && pnpm py:typecheck && pnpm py:test && pnpm eval:offline && pnpm adr:check && pnpm hooks:test && pnpm lint:workflows && pnpm lint:shell
scripts.py:format: cd observer && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.lint:workflows: uv tool run --quiet --from actionlint-py==1.7.12.25 --with shellcheck-py==0.11.0.1 actionlint
scripts.lint:shell: uv tool run --quiet --from shellcheck-py==0.11.0.1 shellcheck -x -P SCRIPTDIR .claude/hooks/*.sh .claude/hooks/test/*.sh
